name: Svelte Agentation
summary: Dev-only Svelte inspector that turns UI annotations into structured context for AI coding agents.
description: A floating annotation toolbar you mount in Svelte apps during development. Click elements or text ranges, add notes and copy structured Markdown in compact, standard, detailed or forensic modes; notes are scoped per route automatically. It inspects source-aware DOM (including open shadow roots), opens files in VS Code, and exposes props, keyboard bindings and annotation/copy callbacks.
contains: dev-only floating toolbar: press i to inspect, click elements to annotate
copies notes as Markdown in compact, standard, detailed or forensic modes
route-scoped note sessions; shadow DOM piercing for web components
captures selector paths, bounds, nearby text, component context and computed styles
shortcuts i, c, r, o, d, esc, enter; grouped selection with shift+ctrl/cmd+click
npm package sv-agentation v0.3.0, MIT licensed
